summary: The change raises Payments' privileged idle limit from 15 minutes to 16 in policy.py and policy-params.json, which violates SES-1. The cited waiver, EXC-0193, expired on 2026-10-27, before review on 2026-10-28, and is scoped to payments.session rather than the policy component that was edited. Ticket approval, independent code review, and control-owner approval of the single head commit are in place, and the change is not an emergency. The attached JUnit report predates the head commit and was produced on a different host than the claimed CI runner, so it does not show the full suite passing on the code being merged.
